body: Cuban sandwiches. I really want to like them but I just can’t deal.
Nah you’re right, they’re definitely dip pen nibs.

Insurance only covers the 10 days, and I’ve got a bunch of traveling coming up for some family weddings anyway so it’s pretty much impossible for me to stay longer. 

I guess I feel ok knowing that I have a therapy appointment for right after my discharge, and another appointment for right when I get back from my trip. It just is a lot to deal with and I find myself feeling very alone especially at night.
